en.title: Mani — A little more cinema. For Windows.
en.description: An IINA-inspired media player for Windows. A calm glass interface, dual subtitles, thoughtful audio controls, and the power of libmpv. Meet Mani Beta 0.1.
en.heroLine2: A lot less in the way.
en.heroDescription:
Your films. Your music. Your moment.
A thoughtfully crafted Windows player, inspired by IINA.
en.heroAlt: Mani playing an original sunrise landscape, with translucent floating playback controls
en.screenshotCaption: Real Mani. A little light, a little glass, and room for the picture.
en.experienceTitle:
Everything within reach.
Nothing in the way.
en.experienceDescription: Thoughtful controls for the details you care about. A quiet interface for everything else.
en.playbackDescription: Float your controls over the picture, dock them at the top or bottom, and let them fade when it is time to watch.
en.subtitlesDescription: Choose two subtitle tracks, then adjust their timing, position, visibility, and ASS override levels independently. Shared text styles stay clearly shared.
en.audioDescription: Choose an output device, load an external audio track, and shape the sound with a ten-band equalizer. Speed and audio delay stay close at hand.
en.subtitlesAlt: Real Mani dual subtitle controls next to a landscape with English and Chinese subtitles
en.audioAlt: Real Mani audio sidebar showing an external audio track and equalizer presets
en.imageNote: Actual app captures. The landscape is an original AI-generated demonstration image.
en.featuresTitle: A player for the way you watch.

features.title: Open. Drop. Play.
features.body: Files, folders, and HTTP(S) media links. Drop something in and settle into your next watch.

features.title: Keep your place.
features.body: Playlists, searchable history, playback resume, and chapters. Pick up where the story left off.

features.title: Subtitles, considered.
features.body: Automatic matching, encoding reload, ASS styling, and image subtitles. With room for a second language.

features.title: Get closer to a moment.
features.body: Fine-tune playback speed, step through frames, repeat an A–B segment, or save a screenshot.

features.title: Your space. Your screen.
features.body: Go fullscreen, float picture in picture, switch to music mode, or open another player window.

features.title: Feels at home.
features.body: A native Windows interface with keyboard, mouse, and gesture controls. Switch between English and Simplified Chinese.

en.storyEyebrow: A FAMILIAR IDEA. A NEW HOME.
en.storyIntro: It started with a simple wish: bring the thoughtful experience of IINA to Windows.
en.storyBody: Mani builds on ideas, interactions, and reusable work from IINA 1.5.1, adapting them to Windows with C#, WinUI 3, and libmpv. The result is a player with its own glass-inspired character and a familiar respect for the thing you came to watch.
en.storyCredit: An independent project, with gratitude to IINA, mpv, and the open-source community. Mani is not an official IINA release.
en.downloadDescription:
A fresh home for your films and music.
Available now as a Windows preview build.
en.downloadInfo: Windows 11 24H2 or later · x64 · Setup installer
en.downloadRuntime: App runtimes included. No developer tools needed.
en.previewNote: Local preview: this download is a local test build.
en.installTitle: A few things before you press play.
en.installIntro: One installer contains the complete app and guides you through setup. This beta uses a test signing certificate; the wizard asks for your consent and Windows administrator approval when trust is needed.

installSteps.title: Check your Windows version.
installSteps.body: Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100) or later, on an x64 PC. ARM64 and older versions are not supported by this package.

installSteps.title: Open the installer.
installSteps.body: Download and open Mani-Beta-0.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe. The full app is included; no ZIP extraction or command-line steps are needed.

installSteps.title: Review, approve, and install.
installSteps.body: If asked, agree to trust the Mani beta certificate, then choose Install and approve the Windows administrator prompt. Setup installs for your Windows account. Windows security prompts may still appear.

en.installFootnote: Already using Mani Beta Test? Close it, then install this package to upgrade. If Windows reports that a newer version is installed, keep that version; do not uninstall just to downgrade.
en.footerLine: A little more cinema. For Windows.
en.creditsBody: Mani original code is GPL-3.0-only. IINA-derived work and third-party components retain their own notices. The installer includes these notices under More → About Mani. The matching application and native component sources accompany the release.
en.creditsImage: App screenshots were captured from Mani 0.5.6.0 using an isolated profile. The scenic demo was generated with OpenAI image generation; it is not a movie still or a performance benchmark.

zh.title: Mani — 让观影更纯粹的 Windows 播放器
zh.description: 受 IINA 启发的 Windows 媒体播放器。通透的玻璃界面、双字幕、细致的音频控制，以及 libmpv 的播放能力。认识 Mani Beta 0.1。
zh.heroDescription:
你的电影，你的音乐，你的片刻。
一款受 IINA 启发、为 Windows 用心打造的播放器。
zh.heroAlt: Mani 播放原创日出风景样片，画面上方悬浮着半透明播放控制栏
zh.screenshotCaption: 真实的 Mani。一点光，一层玻璃，把更多空间留给画面。
zh.experienceTitle:
需要的，触手可及。
其余的，悄然隐去。
zh.experienceDescription: 在意的细节，随手就能调整。专注看电影时，让界面退到幕后。
zh.galleryLabel: 浏览 Mani 界面截图
zh.playbackDescription: 让控制栏悬浮在画面上，或放在顶部、底部。开始沉浸观看时，它会安静地淡出。
zh.subtitlesDescription: 选择两条字幕，分别调整延迟、位置、显示状态和 ASS 覆盖级别。共用的文本样式，也有清楚的适用说明。
zh.audioDescription: 选择输出设备、加载外挂音轨，用十段均衡器调整音色。播放速度和音频延迟，也都近在手边。
zh.subtitlesAlt: 真实 Mani 双字幕设置界面，旁边的风景画面同时显示英文和中文字幕
zh.audioAlt: 真实 Mani 音频侧栏，展示外挂音轨选择和均衡器预设
zh.imageNote: 界面来自实际应用截图；风景为原创 AI 生成演示素材。
zh.featuresEyebrow: 日常的小细节，用起来的大不同

features.title: 打开，拖入，播放。
features.body: 本地文件、文件夹、HTTP(S) 媒体链接。把想看的内容拖进来，准备好进入故事。

features.title: 记得你看到哪里。
features.body: 播放列表、可搜索的历史、断点续播和章节导航，让故事从离开的地方继续。

features.title: 字幕，值得认真对待。
features.body: 自动匹配、编码重载、ASS 样式和图像字幕支持。还可以为另一种语言，再留一行。

features.title: 再靠近精彩一点。
features.body: 调整倍速、逐帧查看、A–B 循环，或者保存一张截图。把喜欢的片刻，多看几遍。

features.title: 你的屏幕，你的方式。
features.body: 全屏沉浸、画中画悬浮、切换音乐模式，或者打开另一个播放窗口，随你的节奏安排。

features.title: 用起来，自然熟悉。
features.body: 原生 Windows 界面，支持键盘、鼠标与手势。英文和简体中文，可以随时切换。

zh.storyTitle:
灵感来自 IINA。
为 Windows 而生。
zh.storyIntro: 一切始于一个简单的愿望：把 IINA 那份细腻的播放体验，带到 Windows。
zh.storyBody: Mani 以 IINA 1.5.1 的交互理念和可复用成果为基础，通过 C#、WinUI 3 和 libmpv 适配 Windows。通透的玻璃视觉，是它自己的表达；把注意力还给内容，是始终不变的初心。
zh.storyCredit: 这是一个独立项目，感谢 IINA、mpv 及开源社区。Mani 并非 IINA 官方发行版。
zh.downloadEyebrow: 下一段故事，从这里开始
zh.downloadDescription:
给电影与音乐，一个新的归属。
现在，以 Windows 预览版与你见面。
zh.downloadInfo: Windows 11 24H2 及以上 · x64 · 安装向导
zh.downloadRuntime: 已包含应用运行时，无需开发工具。
zh.previewNote: 本地预览：此处下载的是本地测试构建。
zh.installTitle: 播放之前，先做一点准备。
zh.installIntro: 一个安装程序，内含完整应用并引导你完成安装。此 Beta 使用测试签名证书；需要信任证书时，向导会征得你的同意并请求 Windows 管理员批准。

installSteps.title: 确认 Windows 版本。
installSteps.body: 需要 Windows 11 24H2（内部版本 26100）或更新版本，以及 x64 电脑。此安装包不支持 ARM64 和更早的 Windows 版本。

installSteps.title: 打开安装程序。
installSteps.body: 下载并打开 Mani-Beta-0.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe。已包含完整应用，无需解压 ZIP 或手动输入命令。

installSteps.title: 确认后，开始安装。
installSteps.body: 如有提示，同意信任 Mani Beta 证书，点击“安装”并批准 Windows 管理员提示。应用会安装到当前 Windows 账户；Windows 仍可能显示安全提示。

zh.installFootnote: 已在使用 Mani Beta Test？关闭应用，直接安装此包即可升级。如果 Windows 提示已安装更新版本，请保留该版本，不必为降级而卸载。
zh.footerLine: 让观影更纯粹的 Windows 播放器。
zh.footerCredit: 独立项目。灵感源自 IINA，由 libmpv 驱动。
zh.creditsTitle: 好的体验，源于共同的创造。
zh.creditsBody: Mani 原创代码采用 GPL-3.0-only 许可。IINA 衍生成果和第三方组件保留各自的许可说明，可在应用的“更多 → 关于 Mani”中查看。应用与原生组件的对应源码随发行版提供。
